{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(sales.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(sales.head())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Check for customer_age == -1
age_missing = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of customers with age -1: {len(age_missing)}')

# Show unique values in revenue
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):')
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])"}
